sceneDescription: A photorealistic supermarket checkout belt displays an overflowing grocery shopping cart tipped over on its side. Bananas and everyday groceries have spilled out, but also—absurdly—a gleaming gold watch lies among them, half-hidden under a bunch of bananas as if hastily thrown in. A small TechCrunch reusable bag and a Modern Retail receipt peek from the pile, while a subtle Jeweller sticker is stuck on the watch’s clasp. The scene is brightly and naturally lit, with the objects arranged in a believable, chaotic sprawl, humorously blending the mundane with the luxurious to comment on AI-driven shopping, discontinued bots, and rising jewelry crime.
